span.p: 3. Goal dependencies and bootstrap skills

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: Fuel or bootstrap goal

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: Coal prerequisite, or coal needed before construction

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: No drill; construction prerequisites available

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: Connected drill has no fuel

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: Fueled drill or full output

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: Cannot safely proceed

div.style: color: rgb(67, 59, 83) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center;

span.p:
stockpile_fuel prerequisite
At least 5 carried coal

div.style: color: rgb(67, 59, 83) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
bootstrap_mining target or prerequisite
Working burner drill, connected output
and at least 5 collected iron ore

div.style: color: rgb(46, 72, 53) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center;

span.p:
rocket_launch target
victory = true with exact source
native:base-game-rocket-launch

div.style: color: rgb(46, 72, 53) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
iron_smelting target
At least 10 carried iron plates
and native produced counter at least 10

div.style: color: rgb(46, 72, 53) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
steam_power target
Lab energy above zero; nonzero network ID
equal to the steam engine network ID

div.style: color: rgb(46, 72, 53) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
automation_science target
At least 10 carried science packs
and native produced counter at least 10

div.style: color: rgb(36, 59, 67) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Dependencies are code, not a model plan
Record a milestone only after its prerequisites
Previously verified milestones stay completed

div.style: color: rgb(75, 65, 45) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p: First incomplete bootstrap prerequisite?

div.style: color: rgb(36, 59, 67) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Offer 5- or 10-coal inventory targets
Walk to observed coal when needed
Gather with five-unit backend macros

div.style: color: rgb(36, 59, 67) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Require 5 coal, one carried drill and chest
Walk to observed iron
Place drill with connected output chest

div.style: color: rgb(36, 59, 67) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Existing drill has no fuel
Gather coal if below 5 carried
Otherwise insert 5 coal

div.style: color: rgb(36, 59, 67) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Fueled connected drill: idle until measured ore grows
Factory-enabled path may first extract up to 50 ore
from a full connected output chest

div.style: color: rgb(89, 53, 63) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Block on missing materials or observed resource,
unverified output connection, or no feasible step

div.style: color: rgb(36, 59, 67) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Skip satisfied steps and check next-step feasibility
No full-game compiler without native factory support

div.style: color: rgb(61, 78, 70) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Check prerequisite-ordered native predicates
Retain previously verified milestones
Defer goal changes during tracked background craft

div.style: color: rgb(61, 78, 70) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Compile the effective capability-aware frontier
Bootstrap, serial or ready-work planner
Then apply committed-capital constraints

div.style: color: rgb(61, 78, 70) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Apply two-failure plan budget
Include connection failure attribution

div.style: color: rgb(61, 78, 70) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Mark blocked
Retain exact reason and failure history
